# Format: VEC|format|width|height|blob-shift|hex(swizzled input)|hex(expected output)
# Independent C# model of SwitchSwizzle.Unswizzle written directly from SwitchSwizzle.cs
# (probe Temp/opencode/swizzleprobe, SDK 10.0.401; no shipped-DLL objects needed because
# the model takes the same caller facts as the Rust port). Inputs use fixed-seed random
# bytes at the exact consumed length. Cases cover a one-GOB RGBA32 permutation, DXT5 and
# DXT1 crops, the RGB24-to-RGB conversion, multi-GOB texel height 2, ASTC HDR, R8, and
# RGBA64 with unaligned dimensions.
VEC|4|16|8|0||
VEC|12|8|8|0||
VEC|3|4|1|0||
VEC|66|20|12|1||
VEC|63|33|17|0||
VEC|10|7|5|0||
VEC|4|30|9|2||
VEC|74|5|5|0||
